buyer_question: Which legal entity will sign the order and receive payment?
evidence_requested: Business registration; legal name; registration number; registered address; current status
verification_method: Check the relevant official registry and match the entity across contract invoice and bank beneficiary

buyer_question: Which work is performed directly and which is subcontracted or sourced through partners?
evidence_requested: Written scope map naming development sourcing cutting sewing decoration inspection packing and shipment roles
verification_method: Compare the written map with live video third-party audit or visit evidence

buyer_question: Does the beneficiary match the approved contracting entity?
evidence_requested: Pro forma invoice; beneficiary details; documented explanation for any difference
verification_method: Independent bank and contract review before payment

buyer_question: Which recent products use comparable fabric construction fit decoration and packing?
evidence_requested: Buyer-authorized examples; coded samples; redacted production records where appropriate
verification_method: Compare evidence with the exact proposed product rather than a broad category claim

buyer_question: Who owns pattern fabric artwork sample comments costing and approval communication?
evidence_requested: Named responsibility matrix and escalation contacts
verification_method: Test the workflow with a controlled development brief

buyer_question: How will the approved fabric and trims be identified in bulk?
evidence_requested: Fabric code; construction; composition; GSM; width; finish; color reference; trim codes
verification_method: Match physical references specifications purchase records and bulk receiving checks

buyer_question: What happens if an approved material is unavailable?
evidence_requested: Written change-control and buyer approval route
verification_method: Review a sample change record or require the rule in the order file

buyer_question: How are sample versions comments measurements and open issues controlled?
evidence_requested: Sample register; comment sheet; measurement report; approval status
verification_method: Trace one sample decision from comment to revised specification

buyer_question: What exact file authorizes bulk production?
evidence_requested: Released tech pack; approved sample reference; material; artwork; label; packing and quantity records
verification_method: Confirm one dated approval state and named release authority

buyer_question: Which incoming first-production in-line measurement finishing and packing checks apply?
evidence_requested: Product-specific quality plan and records
verification_method: Match checkpoints to approved requirements owners evidence and escalation rules

buyer_question: How are repeated defects contained corrected and rechecked?
evidence_requested: Defect log; root-cause or corrective-action record; reinspection result
verification_method: Review whether records identify affected units lots owners and closure evidence

buyer_question: Who decides whether the finished lot can ship?
evidence_requested: Inspection brief; sampled results; defect counts; corrective action; release decision
verification_method: Confirm the decision rule before inspection and retain the signed result

buyer_question: Who holds the certificate and what site product process standard and dates does it cover?
evidence_requested: Complete current certificate and supporting scope
verification_method: Verify through the issuer accreditation body or authoritative database where available

buyer_question: Which test or document is required for this product and destination?
evidence_requested: Buyer requirement; laboratory report; sample identity; method; result and date
verification_method: Match the tested sample and scope to the ordered product and current market requirement

buyer_question: Who approves fiber care origin identity environmental and performance statements?
evidence_requested: Market-specific label file; claim substantiation; named approval owner
verification_method: Review with qualified compliance support for the destination market

buyer_question: What line time material availability and external process capacity are reserved?
evidence_requested: Production plan with assumptions constraints and subcontracted steps
verification_method: Compare timing with material lead time sample approvals and actual production milestones

buyer_question: Which costs assumptions exclusions and validity dates are included?
evidence_requested: Itemized quotation covering product decoration labels packaging testing inspection and freight handoff
verification_method: Compare shortlisted suppliers against one controlled brief

buyer_question: How will SKU size color roster barcode and carton allocation be reconciled?
evidence_requested: Packing specification; SKU file; roster; packing list; carton map
verification_method: Run a reconciliation before shipment and retain exception records

buyer_question: Which approved references and changes will be retained for a reorder?
evidence_requested: Master record for materials measurements artwork labels packaging and revision history
verification_method: Review availability changes before repeating the prior specification

buyer_question: Which open items prevent deposit sample approval bulk release or shipment?
evidence_requested: Open-item register with status owner due date evidence and decision gate
verification_method: Do not convert unknowns into assumed approvals; close or explicitly accept each risk
